patch.value: Stream TOON blocks or JSON lines for lane and conflict changes with bounded polling and SIGINT shutdown.
Child-process watch tests observe pushed conflicting commits and graceful shutdown.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: serial status polling emits only changed lane rows and newly predicted, changed or resolved conflicts; TOON blocks or JSON lines, minimum two seconds, interruptible SIGINT shutdown. No fetch or remote writes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Both real CLI child watchers pass: unchanged polls emit nothing; a committed and pushed branch change emits lane_changed and conflict_predicted naming the source path; JSON lines and decoded TOON blocks agree; SIGINT exits zero.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof: restoring only runCommand from the base branch made the JSON child watcher emit a one-shot status instead of watch events; focused test exited 1 (0 pass, 1 fail) waiting for lane_added. Restored implementation. Source imports require no dist rebuild.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Shutdown regression found and fixed: the host renders undefined JSON or an empty TOON object when a streaming command returns void. Register renderers scoped to swarm status plus its completion marker; preserve native rendering for ordinary status and every other command. Strengthened child assertions reject trailing non-event records. Final focused suite passes 12/12, including renderer ownership boundaries and pair-order invariance.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Strengthened real-push regression: an independent clone creates the conflicting commit; the watched repository stays unchanged and silent before push. Pushing into the watched lane ref emits lane_changed and conflict_predicted. Both TOON and JSON child watchers pass, with zero trailing non-event records and clean SIGINT exits. Focused suite: 12/12.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Coverage-run test synchronization correction: wait for fully decoded framed records for both initial lanes, and a complete conflict record, instead of matching partial pipe text. This removes the initial-output race under load. Focused suite passes 12/12 with independent-clone push, silent polls and clean shutdown.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final gates: npm run release:check and bun run release:check pass normally and with CI=1, isolated HOME, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. Each run: 93/93 tests plus 1/1 packed npm/native Bun acceptance, zero failures/skips/cancellations, 21 authored source files at 100 percent statements, branches, functions and lines. Statements/lines 1337/1337; functions 72/72; branches 601/601 for normal npm and 600/600 for the other runs. Identity, types, lint, zero duplication, docstrings, production audit, package allowlist, changelog and publish attestation pass. Three behavioural revert proofs are recorded. Publication remains maintainer-gated.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1: fixing packed project activation by removing the direct TOON runtime dependency and exercising pack, extraction and project-scope directory installation through the real host. Main is already contained in the PR branch. Will verify native watch streaming, a built-import guard and behavioural revert proof before release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Pinned SDK inspection: sdk/testing publicly exports encodeToon backed by the host codec, while the command SDK has no streaming renderer service. Watch now uses that SDK export; package.json and the lockfile have zero runtime dependencies. Packed acceptance installs only the pm host, extracts npm pack, installs the extracted directory at project scope, rejects all activation warnings, and checks direct Node/Bun plus npx/bunx commands and TOON/JSON watch children. The built artifact guard rejects non-Node, non-SDK bare imports.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1 behavioural revert proof: restoring only the direct watch import from @toon-format/toon (aliasing encode to preserve the unchanged function body), rebuilding and running npm run test:install fails 0/2. The real extracted-directory project installation exits 1 with runtime_activation_status failed and Cannot find package @toon-format/toon; the independent dist import guard reports forbidden runtime import @toon-format/toon. Restored the SDK import and rebuilt. Before the revert, the fixed packed acceptance passed 2/2, including npm/npx and native Bun/bunx, direct host invocation, both watch formats, silent polls, SIGINT shutdown and path privacy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The mandatory pm-linked run exposed inherited PM_SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT/PM_SOURCE_PM_PATH in the existing packed fixture: host commands used the caller workspace for Git operations. Bound source workspace, source tracker and global tracker to scratch consumer context, cleared inherited build leases, injected a decoy source context deliberately, and added an exact returned lane-path assertion. Verified and removed the clean test-created lane, branch and lane config. Package branch and source files were preserved. Rerunning linked tests with the corrected fixture.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final fixture verification: pm test pm-swarm-watch --run --progress passes both linked commands (6/6 watch tests and 2/2 packed acceptance, no skipped tests). Tracker test-result recording is disabled by project policy, so this comment preserves the receipt without changing policy. Repeated the direct-import-only behavioural revert against the final isolated fixture: npm run test:install fails 0/2 with missing-package project activation and forbidden runtime import. Restored SDK import and rebuilt. No test lane, branch or lane config remains in the package repository. Starting all four release gate configurations.

value.text: GitHub head 489b26a: Node 26 and CodeQL passed; Node 22 failed in the packed fixture cleanup hook with ENOTEMPTY while recursively removing the scratch Bun cache. Reclaimed the item. Replacing synchronous scratch removal with awaited fs.rm and the same bounded retry policy so concurrent child/cache cleanup can settle. Will validate packed acceptance on the installed Node 22 runtime, rerun final release configurations, commit this fixture correction with tracker history, and monitor the new head. No thread replies or mentions.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 2: watch emits a completed-poll heartbeat to stderr only when PM_SWARM_TEST_POLL_HEARTBEAT=1. JSON and TOON integration checks observe two additional completed polls before checking unchanged output and unpushed-commit silence; packed npm and native Bun consumers use the same completion evidence. Removed fixed 2300 ms synchronization delays. Normal output is unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The two-poll assertions also wait for the initial poll-complete heartbeat before capturing the marker baseline. This prevents pipe delivery order from counting the initial poll as one of the two later polls. Restarting the release matrix after this final assertion refinement.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 2 final validation after the initial-heartbeat baseline refinement: pm test pm-swarm-watch --run --progress passed 6/6 focused watch tests and 2/2 packed acceptance tests. npm run release:check and bun run release:check pass normally and with isolated HOME, disabled global/system Git config and CI=1; each passes 97/97 suite tests, 2/2 packed acceptance tests, and 100 percent in all four coverage dimensions across 21 source files. Two later completed polls are required for source and packed silence assertions. Identity, type checks, lint, zero duplication, docstrings, production audit, package contents, generated changelog and publish attestation pass. Will push the combined code/tracker commit and poll GitHub checks every 60 seconds for up to 30 minutes. Leaving status in progress for orchestrator verification.
